abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze the characteristics of hepatic metastasis of pure immature ovarian teratoma and explore its proper diagnosis and treatment. METHODS: Eighteen cases of hepatic metastasis of pure immature ovarian teratoma were included in this study. The clinical stage, operation, chemotherapy and histopathology of primary and secondary tumors as well as the data from long term follow-ups were analyzed retrospectively. RESULTS: All of the hepatic metastatic tumors were located on the surface of the liver. 61.1% (11/18) of them were clinical stage III and 44.4% (8/18) were grade 1 at first operation. The hepatic metastatic rate was 16.7% (3/18) in the standard adjuvant chemotherapy group but increased markedly to 31.2% (15/48) in the irregular chemotherapy group. Auxiliary diagnostic methods could not indicate the correct results. The surgical resection rate of hepatic metastasis of pure immature ovarian teratoma was 94.4% (17/18). There were less complications in the group with tumor diameter less than 15 cm. The follow-up time ranged from 3 to 205 months with a mean of 20.9 months. The 3-year-survival rate was 77.8% (14/18), and mortality rate was 22.2%. The 5- and 10-year-survival rate was 55.6% (10/18) and 38.9% (7/18), respectively. The rate of loss in follow-up was 22.2% (4/18) and 38.9% (7/18), respectively, and one patient has survived for more than 17 years. CONCLUSIONS: The hepatic metastatic rate of pure immature ovarian teratoma could be decreased using standard adjuvant chemotherapy. Suitable surgical treatment could reduce complications and improve the prognosis for patients.
abstract_ja: 目的：純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移の特徴を分析し、適切な診断と治療を検討する。方法：純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移18例を本研究に含めた。原発腫瘍と二次腫瘍の臨床病期、手術、化学療法、病理組織学的所見、および長期フォローアップのデータを後方視的に解析した。結果：肝転移腫瘍はすべて肝表面に存在した。初回手術時点で61.1%（11/18）が臨床病期III期、44.4%（8/18）がグレード1であった。肝転移率は、標準的補助化学療法群で16.7%（3/18）であったが、不規則な化学療法群では31.2%（15/48）に著明に上昇した。補助診断法では正確な結果が得られなかった。純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移に対する外科的切除率は94.4%（17/18）であった。腫瘍径15cm未満の群では合併症が少なかった。追跡期間は3～205か月（平均20.9か月）であった。3年生存率は77.8%（14/18）、死亡率は22.2%であった。5年および10年生存率はそれぞれ55.6%（10/18）と38.9%（7/18）であった。追跡不能率は、それぞれ22.2%（4/18）と38.9%（7/18）であった。1例は17年以上生存している。結論：標準的補助化学療法により、純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移率を低下させることができる。適切な外科治療は合併症を減らし、予後を改善しうる。
